children: Genprex reported no revenue in either period, while its net loss widened 12% year over year, primarily as higher preclinical, research, professional services and payroll expenses more than offset the absence of $455,549 in prior-year other financing costs.
² Reported as “Net loss”. ³ Reported as “Net loss per share applicable to common stockholders — basic and diluted”.
: The Phase 2a expansion continues enrolling and treating patients; the trial combines REQORSA with Tagrisso for late-stage NSCLC.
: The Phase 2 expansion is enrolling patients; Genprex expects to enroll the first 25 patients for interim analysis by year-end 2026.
: Genprex is collaborating with Roche Diagnostics to validate biomarkers for NSCLC patient selection in clinical trials.
: Preclinical animal studies continue following the February FDA meeting; toxicology studies are expected to enable an IND filing.
: Cash and cash equivalents were $15.3M at September 30, 2026; the company estimates funding operations and planned trials into the second half of 2027.
